ko.title: 더 넓어진 노후 자금 공간: 2027년 401(k) 및 IRA 한도 변경이 저축자에게 의미하는 바

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service reviews retirement contribution caps and adjusts them for inflation.
segments.tr: 매년 가을, 미국 국세청(IRS)은 은퇴 계좌 납입 한도를 검토하고 인플레이션을 반영하여 조정합니다.

segments.src: The announcement for the 2027 tax year usually arrives between late October and mid-November, so many savers are watching for it now.
segments.tr: 2027 과세 연도에 대한 발표는 보통 10월 말에서 11월 중간 사이에 이루어지므로, 많은 저축자들이 현재 이를 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: This article explains how the limits work, what analysts currently expect, and which workers may gain the most.
segments.tr: 본 문서에서는 한도 조정 방식, 분석가들의 현재 전망, 그리고 어떤 근로자가 가장 큰 혜택을 받는지 설명합니다.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or tax advice.
segments.tr: 이 내용은 일반적인 정보 제공 목적이며 개인적인 재정이나 세무 자문이 아닙니다.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## 수치에 관한 참고 사항

segments.src: At the time of writing, the figures below for 2027 are **projections from benefit consultants, not official IRS numbers**.
segments.tr: 작성 시점 기준으로 아래 제시된 2027년 수치는 **복리후생 컨설턴트들의 추정치이며 IRS의 공식 수치가 아닙니다**.

segments.src: Official limits are published by the IRS, so check IRS.gov before you change any contributions.
segments.tr: 공식 한도는 IRS에 의해 공표되므로 납입금을 변경하기 전에 IRS.gov를 확인하시기 바랍니다.

segments.src: The 2026 limits, by contrast, are final and serve as the baseline.
segments.tr: 반면, 2026년 한도는 확정된 수치이며 기준선 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: ## How the Annual Adjustment Works
segments.tr: ## 연례 조정 작동 방식

segments.src: Many retirement limits are indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: 많은 은퇴 한도는 물가상승률에 연동됩니다.

segments.src: The IRS rounds the adjusted amounts in set increments.
segments.tr: IRS는 조정된 금액을 정해진 단위로 반올림(절상/절사)합니다.

segments.src: Because of that rounding, a modest rise in prices may not move every limit each year.
segments.tr: 이러한 반올림 때문에 물가가 완만하게 상승하더라도 매년 모든 한도가 늘어나지는 않을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Some caps jump while others stay flat.
segments.tr: 일부 한도는 급격히 오르는 반면 다른 한도는 동결되기도 합니다.

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## 한눈에 보는 수치

| 401(k), 403(b), and most 457(b) employee deferral | $24,500 | about $25,500 |
| Catch-up, age 50 and over | $8,000 | about $8,500 |

segments.src: If the projections hold, a worker under 50 could defer roughly $1,000 more into a workplace plan than in 2026.
segments.tr: 추정치가 유지된다면 50세 미만 근로자는 직장 은퇴 플랜에 2026년보다 약 $1,000 더 납입을 이연할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: A worker aged 60 to 63 could contribute up to about $37,250 in employee deferrals, counting the super catch-up.
segments.tr: 60세에서 63세 사이의 근로자는 슈퍼 추가 납입을 포함하여 직원 납입 이연으로 최대 약 $37,250까지 납입할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Catch-Up Rules to Understand
segments.tr: ## 숙지해야 할 추가 납입 규정

segments.src: **Age 50 and over.** Workers who reach 50 by the end of the year can add a catch-up amount on top of the standard limit.
segments.tr: **50세 이상.** 해당 연도 말까지 50세에 도달하는 근로자는 기본 한도에 더해 추가 납입 금액을 더할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: **Ages 60 to 63.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, people in this window may use a higher catch-up limit.
segments.tr: **60세~63세.** SECURE 2.0 Act에 따라 이 연령대에 해당하는 사람들은 더 높은 추가 납입 한도를 적용받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: It is generally set at the greater of a fixed dollar amount or 150% of the regular catch-up.
segments.tr: 이는 일반적으로 고정 달러 금액과 일반 추가 납입 한도의 150% 중 더 큰 금액으로 설정됩니다.

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: 해당 연도 중에 64세가 되면 보통 표준 추가 납입 한도로 돌아갑니다.

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **고소득자에 대한 Roth 적용 의무.** 2026년부터 플랜 스폰서로부터 받은 전년도 임금이 인플레이션에 연동된 임계값을 초과하는 임직원은 추가 납입을 Roth(후과세) 방식으로 진행해야 합니다.

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: 이는 해당 금액에 대한 즉각적인 공제가 없음을 의미하지만, 요건을 충족하는 인출 시 나중에 비과세 혜택을 받을 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: 이 기준 소득은 2027년에 약 $155,000로 인상될 것으로 전망됩니다.

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: 귀하의 플랜이 Roth 옵션을 제공하는지 여부와 이 규정을 관리하는 방식은 고용주에 따라 다릅니다.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## 누가 가장 큰 혜택을 받는가?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **고소득자 및 경력 후기 저축자.** 이미 플랜 한도를 채우고 있는 사람들이 상한선 인상 혜택을 가장 크게 활용할 수 있습니다. 60세에서 63세 사이의 사람들은 절대적인 금액 면에서 가장 큰 증가 폭을 얻게 됩니다.

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **고용주 매칭 혜택이 있는 근로자.** 상한선이 높아진다고 해서 매칭 비율이 자동으로 오르지는 않지만, 납입 비율이 급여의 일정 비율로 설정되어 있다면 최고 매칭액에 도달하는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다. 항상 전체 매칭 혜택을 먼저 확보하세요.

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **저축을 늦게 시작한 사람들.** 추가 납입 규정은 부족했던 저축을 보충할 수 있는 기회를 제공하지만, 실제 활용 가능한 금액은 소득과 현금 흐름에 따라 제한됩니다.

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **저소득 및 중위 소득자.** 많은 사람들이 납입 한도에 전혀 도달하지 못하므로, 더 높은 상한선이 커다란 변화를 주지는 않습니다. 이들에게는 납입 비율을 단 1퍼센트포인트라도 올리는 것이 더 중요할 수 있습니다. 자격을 갖춘 저소득 가구는 연방 Saver's Credit 혜택을 활용할 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: ## IRA Limits: Watch the Rounding
segments.tr: ## IRA 한도: 반올림 단위 확인

segments.src: IRA limits move in $500 steps, so forecasters are split on whether the 2027 cap stays at $7,500 or rises to $8,000.
segments.tr: IRA 한도는 $500 단위로 조정되므로, 예측 기관들은 2027년 상한선이 $7,500에 머물지 $8,000로 오를지에 대해 의견이 갈리고 있습니다.

segments.src: The IRA catch-up has been indexed in $100 steps.
segments.tr: IRA 추가 납입 한도는 $100 단위로 조정되어 왔습니다.

segments.src: Separately, eligibility to deduct traditional IRA contributions or contribute directly to a Roth IRA depends on income and on whether you are covered by a workplace plan.
segments.tr: 이와 별개로, 기존 IRA 납입금의 공제 가능 여부나 Roth IRA에 직접 납입할 수 있는 자격은 소득 수준과 직장 플랜 가입 여부에 따라 결정됩니다.

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: 이러한 소득 구간 역시 매년 조정됩니다.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## 가을철 실천 단계

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **급여 공제액 검토.** 많은 플랜에서 비율이나 금액을 설정할 수 있습니다. 한도를 채우고 싶다면 상한선을 급여 지급 횟수로 나누세요.

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: 2. **조기 납입 완료 주의.** 연초에 한도에 도달하면 일부 고용주는 남은 달 동안 매칭 제공을 중단합니다. 납입금을 균등하게 분산하면 매칭 금액을 전액 받는 데 도움이 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **플랜의 Roth 옵션 확인.** 추가 납입 소득 임계값 근처에 있는 경우 특히 중요한 사항입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Coordinate accounts.** The 401(k) limit applies per person across employers, while IRA limits are separate.
segments.tr: 4. **계좌 조정.** 401(k) 한도는 여러 고용주를 통틀어 개인당 적용되는 반면, IRA 한도는 별도로 적용됩니다.

segments.src: 5. **Confirm figures with official sources.** Use IRS.gov or a qualified tax professional once the official notice is out.
segments.tr: 5. **공식 출처를 통해 수치 확인.** 공식 공고가 나온 후 IRS.gov나 자격을 갖춘 세무 전문가를 통해 확인하세요.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: A larger contribution ceiling gives savers more room, but room is not the same as money in the account.
segments.tr: 납입 상한선이 높아지면 저축자에게 더 많은 여유가 생기지만, 여유 공간이 계좌의 실질적인 돈과 같은 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: For most households, the biggest gains come from steady contributions, capturing the employer match, and keeping costs low.
segments.tr: 대부분의 가구에 있어 가장 큰 이득은 꾸준한 납입, 고용주 매칭 확보, 그리고 수수료 저감에서 나옵니다.

segments.src: Higher limits mainly help those who are already saving at the maximum and want to put away more.
segments.tr: 높아진 한도는 주로 이미 최대 한도로 저축하고 있으며 더 많은 금액을 저축하고자 하는 이들에게 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **有雇主匹配的员工。** 更高的上限不会提高匹配度，但如果您的缴款比例与薪酬挂钩，它可以帮助您达到匹配度。务必首先获得全部匹配。

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **起步较晚的储蓄者。** 补缴条款提供了一种弥补失去的进度的方法，尽管您可以使用的金额受制于您的收入和现金流。

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **中低收入者。** 许多人根本没有达到限额，因此更高的上限改变不大。对他们来说，将缴款比例提高哪怕一个百分点可能更重要。联邦储蓄者税收抵免也可能对符合条件的低收入家庭有所帮助。

segments.src: ## IRA Limits: Watch the Rounding
segments.tr: ## IRA限额：注意取整

segments.src: IRA limits move in $500 steps, so forecasters are split on whether the 2027 cap stays at $7,500 or rises to $8,000.
segments.tr: IRA限额以500美元为单位变动，因此预测人士对2027年的上限是保持在7,500美元还是上升到8,000美元意见不一。

segments.src: The IRA catch-up has been indexed in $100 steps.
segments.tr: IRA补缴额一直以100美元为单位进行索引。

segments.src: Separately, eligibility to deduct traditional IRA contributions or contribute directly to a Roth IRA depends on income and on whether you are covered by a workplace plan.
segments.tr: 另外，扣除传统IRA缴款或直接缴款至罗斯IRA的资格取决于收入以及您是否参加了工作单位计划。

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: 这些收入范围每年也会进行调整。

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## 秋季的实际步骤

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **检查您的工资延期缴款。** 许多计划允许您设置百分比或美元金额。如果您想达到限额，请将上限除以您的发薪周期。

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: 2. **谨防前期集中缴款。** 如果您在年初较早达到上限，一些雇主会停止在剩余月份进行匹配。分散缴款可以帮助您收集全部匹配。

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **检查您的计划的罗斯选项。** 如果您接近补缴工资阈值，这一点最重要。

segments.src: 4. **Coordinate accounts.** The 401(k) limit applies per person across employers, while IRA limits are separate.
segments.tr: 4. **协调账户。** 401(k)限额适用于每个雇主的个人，而IRA限额是分开的。

segments.src: 5. **Confirm figures with official sources.** Use IRS.gov or a qualified tax professional once the official notice is out.
segments.tr: 5. **向官方来源确认数字。** 一旦官方通知发布，请使用 IRS.gov 或合格的税务专业人士。

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: A larger contribution ceiling gives savers more room, but room is not the same as money in the account.
segments.tr: 更高的缴款上限给储蓄者留出了更多空间，但有空间并不等于账户里有钱。

segments.src: For most households, the biggest gains come from steady contributions, capturing the employer match, and keeping costs low.
segments.tr: 对大多数家庭而言，最大的收益来自于稳定的缴款、获得雇主匹配以及保持低成本。

segments.src: Higher limits mainly help those who are already saving at the maximum and want to put away more.
segments.tr: 更高的限额主要帮助那些已经按最高标准储蓄并希望存入更多资金的人。

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service reviews retirement contribution caps and adjusts them for inflation.
segments.tr: हर पतझड़ में, इंटरनल रेवेन्यू सर्विस (IRS) सेवानिवृत्ति योगदान की अधिकतम सीमाओं की समीक्षा करती है और मुद्रास्फीति के लिए उन्हें समायोजित करती है।

segments.src: The announcement for the 2027 tax year usually arrives between late October and mid-November, so many savers are watching for it now.
segments.tr: 2027 कर वर्ष के लिए घोषणा आमतौर पर अक्टूबर के अंत और नवंबर के मध्य के बीच आती है, इसलिए कई बचतकर्ता अब इसका इंतजार कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: This article explains how the limits work, what analysts currently expect, and which workers may gain the most.
segments.tr: यह लेख बताता है कि ये सीमाएं कैसे काम करती हैं, विश्लेषक वर्तमान में क्या उम्मीद कर रहे हैं, और किन कर्मचारियों को सबसे अधिक लाभ हो सकता है।

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or tax advice.
segments.tr: यह सामान्य जानकारी है, व्यक्तिगत वित्तीय या कर सलाह नहीं।

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## आंकड़ों पर एक नोट

segments.src: At the time of writing, the figures below for 2027 are **projections from benefit consultants, not official IRS numbers**.
segments.tr: लेखन के समय, 2027 के लिए नीचे दिए गए आंकड़े **बेनिफिट कंसल्टेंट्स के अनुमान हैं, न कि आधिकारिक IRS आंकड़े**।

segments.src: Official limits are published by the IRS, so check IRS.gov before you change any contributions.
segments.tr: आधिकारिक सीमाएं IRS द्वारा प्रकाशित की जाती हैं, इसलिए अपने योगदान में कोई भी बदलाव करने से पहले IRS.gov देखें।

segments.src: The 2026 limits, by contrast, are final and serve as the baseline.
segments.tr: इसके विपरीत, 2026 की सीमाएं अंतिम हैं और आधार रेखा के रूप में काम करती हैं।

segments.src: ## How the Annual Adjustment Works
segments.tr: ## वार्षिक समायोजन कैसे काम करता है

segments.src: Many retirement limits are indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: सेवानिवृत्ति की कई सीमाएं मुद्रास्फीति से जुड़ी होती हैं।

segments.src: The IRS rounds the adjusted amounts in set increments.
segments.tr: IRS समायोजित राशियों को निर्धारित वृद्धि में राउंड ऑफ (पूर्णांक में बदलना) करता है।

segments.src: Because of that rounding, a modest rise in prices may not move every limit each year.
segments.tr: उस राउंडिंग के कारण, कीमतों में मामूली वृद्धि हर साल हर सीमा को नहीं बदल सकती है।

segments.src: Some caps jump while others stay flat.
segments.tr: कुछ सीमाएं बढ़ जाती हैं जबकि अन्य स्थिर रहती हैं।

segments.tr: ## एक नज़र में आंकड़े

segments.src: If the projections hold, a worker under 50 could defer roughly $1,000 more into a workplace plan than in 2026.
segments.tr: यदि अनुमान सही रहते हैं, तो 50 वर्ष से कम आयु का कर्मचारी 2026 की तुलना में कार्यस्थल योजना में लगभग $1,000 अधिक आस्थगित (defer) कर सकता है।

segments.src: A worker aged 60 to 63 could contribute up to about $37,250 in employee deferrals, counting the super catch-up.
segments.tr: 60 से 63 वर्ष की आयु का कर्मचारी सुपर कैच-अप को मिलाकर, कर्मचारी आस्थगन में लगभग $37,250 तक का योगदान कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Catch-Up Rules to Understand
segments.tr: ## समझने के लिए कैच-अप नियम

segments.src: **Age 50 and over.** Workers who reach 50 by the end of the year can add a catch-up amount on top of the standard limit.
segments.tr: **50 वर्ष और उससे अधिक।** जो कर्मचारी वर्ष के अंत तक 50 वर्ष के हो जाते हैं, वे मानक सीमा के ऊपर एक कैच-अप राशि जोड़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: **Ages 60 to 63.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, people in this window may use a higher catch-up limit.
segments.tr: **60 से 63 वर्ष।** SECURE 2.0 एक्ट के तहत, इस आयु वर्ग के लोग उच्च कैच-अप सीमा का उपयोग कर सकते हैं।

segments.src: It is generally set at the greater of a fixed dollar amount or 150% of the regular catch-up.
segments.tr: यह आमतौर पर एक निश्चित डॉलर राशि या नियमित कैच-अप के 150% में से जो भी अधिक हो, उस पर निर्धारित होता है।

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: यदि आप वर्ष के दौरान 64 वर्ष के हो जाते हैं, तो आप आमतौर पर मानक कैच-अप पर वापस आ जाते हैं।

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **उच्च आय वालों के लिए रोथ (Roth) आवश्यकता।** 2026 से शुरू होकर, जिन कर्मचारियों का पिछले वर्ष का वेतन योजना के प्रायोजक से एक अनुक्रमित सीमा से अधिक था, उन्हें रोथ (कर-पश्चात) आधार पर कैच-अप योगदान करना होगा।

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: इसका मतलब है कि उन डॉलर के लिए कोई अग्रिम कर कटौती नहीं होगी, लेकिन योग्य निकासी बाद में कर-मुक्त हो सकती है।

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: यह सीमा 2027 के लिए लगभग $155,000 तक बढ़ने का अनुमान है।

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: क्या आपकी योजना रोथ विकल्प प्रदान करती है, और यह इस नियम का प्रशासन कैसे करती है, यह आपके नियोक्ता पर निर्भर करता है।

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## किसे सबसे अधिक लाभ होता है?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **उच्च आय वाले और देर से करियर शुरू करने वाले बचतकर्ता।** जो लोग पहले से ही अपनी योजना का अधिकतम उपयोग कर रहे हैं, उनके पास उच्च सीमा का उपयोग करने की सबसे अधिक गुंजाइश है। 60 से 63 वर्ष की आयु वालों को पूर्ण डॉलर में सबसे बड़ी वृद्धि मिलती है।

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **नियोक्ता मैच वाले कर्मचारी।** उच्च सीमा मैच को नहीं बढ़ाती है, लेकिन यदि आपकी योगदान दर वेतन के प्रतिशत से जुड़ी है तो यह आपको उस तक पहुंचने में मदद कर सकती है। हमेशा पहले पूरा मैच प्राप्त करें।

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **देर से बचत शुरू करने वाले।** कैच-अप प्रावधान खोई हुई जमीन को पूरा करने का एक तरीका प्रदान करते हैं, हालांकि आप जिस राशि का उपयोग कर सकते हैं वह आपकी आय और नकदी प्रवाह द्वारा सीमित है।

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **कम और मध्यम आय वाले।** बहुत से लोग सीमा तक नहीं पहुंचते हैं, इसलिए उच्च सीमा से बहुत कम बदलाव आता है। उनके लिए, योगदान दर को एक प्रतिशत अंक भी बढ़ाना अधिक मायने रख सकता है। संघीय सेवर क्रेडिट (Saver's Credit) भी पात्र कम आय वाले परिवारों की मदद कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## IRA Limits: Watch the Rounding
segments.tr: ## IRA सीमाएं: राउंडिंग पर ध्यान दें

segments.src: IRA limits move in $500 steps, so forecasters are split on whether the 2027 cap stays at $7,500 or rises to $8,000.
segments.tr: IRA सीमाएं $500 के चरणों में चलती हैं, इसलिए पूर्वानुमान लगाने वाले इस बात पर बंटे हुए हैं कि 2027 की सीमा $7,500 पर रहती है या $8,000 तक बढ़ जाती है।

segments.src: The IRA catch-up has been indexed in $100 steps.
segments.tr: IRA कैच-अप को $100 के चरणों में अनुक्रमित किया गया है।

segments.src: Separately, eligibility to deduct traditional IRA contributions or contribute directly to a Roth IRA depends on income and on whether you are covered by a workplace plan.
segments.tr: अलग से, पारंपरिक IRA योगदान में कटौती करने या सीधे रोथ IRA में योगदान करने की पात्रता आय पर और इस बात पर निर्भर करती है कि क्या आप कार्यस्थल योजना द्वारा कवर किए गए हैं।

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: इन आय श्रेणियों को भी हर साल समायोजित किया जाता है।

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## पतझड़ के लिए व्यावहारिक कदम

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **अपने पेरोल आस्थगन की समीक्षा करें।** कई योजनाएं आपको एक प्रतिशत या डॉलर राशि निर्धारित करने देती हैं। यदि आप एक सीमा तक पहुंचना चाहते हैं, तो सीमा को अपनी वेतन अवधि से विभाजित करें।

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: 2. **फ्रंट-लोडिंग से सावधान रहें।** यदि आप वर्ष की शुरुआत में ही सीमा तक पहुंच जाते हैं, तो कुछ नियोक्ता शेष महीनों के लिए मैच करना बंद कर देते हैं। योगदान को फैलाने से आपको पूरा मैच प्राप्त करने में मदद मिल सकती है।

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **अपनी योजना के रोथ (Roth) विकल्पों की जांच करें।** यदि आप कैच-अप वेतन सीमा के करीब हैं तो यह सबसे ज्यादा मायने रखता है।

segments.src: 4. **Coordinate accounts.** The 401(k) limit applies per person across employers, while IRA limits are separate.
segments.tr: 4. **खातों का समन्वय करें।** 401(k) सीमा नियोक्ताओं के बीच प्रति व्यक्ति लागू होती है, जबकि IRA सीमाएं अलग हैं।

segments.src: 5. **Confirm figures with official sources.** Use IRS.gov or a qualified tax professional once the official notice is out.
segments.tr: 5. **आधिकारिक स्रोतों के साथ आंकड़ों की पुष्टि करें।** आधिकारिक नोटिस आने के बाद IRS.gov या किसी योग्य कर पेशेवर का उपयोग करें।

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## निष्कर्ष

segments.src: A larger contribution ceiling gives savers more room, but room is not the same as money in the account.

es.title: Mayor espacio para el fondo de jubilación: Qué podrían significar para los ahorradores los límites de 401(k) e IRA para 2027

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service reviews retirement contribution caps and adjusts them for inflation.
segments.tr: Cada otoño, el Servicio de Impuestos Internos (IRS) revisa los topes de aportación a la jubilación y los ajusta por inflación.

segments.src: The announcement for the 2027 tax year usually arrives between late October and mid-November, so many savers are watching for it now.
segments.tr: El anuncio para el año fiscal 2027 suele llegar entre finales de octubre y mediados de noviembre, por lo que muchos ahorradores lo están esperando ahora.

segments.src: This article explains how the limits work, what analysts currently expect, and which workers may gain the most.
segments.tr: Este artículo explica cómo funcionan los límites, qué esperan actualmente los analistas y qué trabajadores podrían beneficiarse más.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or tax advice.
segments.tr: Es información general, no asesoramiento financiero o fiscal personal.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Una nota sobre las cifras

segments.src: At the time of writing, the figures below for 2027 are **projections from benefit consultants, not official IRS numbers**.
segments.tr: En el momento de escribir esto, las cifras a continuación para 2027 son **proyecciones de consultores de beneficios, no cifras oficiales del IRS**.

segments.src: Official limits are published by the IRS, so check IRS.gov before you change any contributions.
segments.tr: Los límites oficiales los publica el IRS, así que consulte IRS.gov antes de modificar sus aportaciones.

segments.src: The 2026 limits, by contrast, are final and serve as the baseline.
segments.tr: Los límites de 2026, en cambio, son definitivos y sirven como base.

segments.src: ## How the Annual Adjustment Works
segments.tr: ## Cómo funciona el ajuste anual

segments.src: Many retirement limits are indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: Muchos límites de jubilación están indexados a la inflación.

segments.src: The IRS rounds the adjusted amounts in set increments.
segments.tr: El IRS redondea los montos ajustados en incrementos fijados.

segments.src: Because of that rounding, a modest rise in prices may not move every limit each year.
segments.tr: Debido a ese redondeo, es posible que un modesto aumento de los precios no mueva todos los límites cada año.

segments.src: Some caps jump while others stay flat.
segments.tr: Algunos topes aumentan mientras que otros se mantienen estables.

segments.tr: ## Las cifras de un vistazo

segments.tr: Si se mantienen las proyecciones, un trabajador menor de 50 años podría diferir aproximadamente $1,000 más en un plan de empleo que en 2026.

segments.tr: Un trabajador de 60 a 63 años podría aportar hasta unos $37,250 en aplazamientos de empleados, contando la súper aportación adicional.

segments.src: ## Catch-Up Rules to Understand
segments.tr: ## Reglas de aportación adicional que debe entender

segments.src: **Age 50 and over.** Workers who reach 50 by the end of the year can add a catch-up amount on top of the standard limit.
segments.tr: **50 años o más.** Los trabajadores que cumplan 50 años al final del año pueden añadir una cantidad adicional encima del límite estándar.

segments.src: **Ages 60 to 63.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, people in this window may use a higher catch-up limit.
segments.tr: **De 60 a 63 años.** Según la Ley SECURE 2.0, las personas en este rango de edad pueden usar un límite de aportación adicional más alto.

segments.src: It is generally set at the greater of a fixed dollar amount or 150% of the regular catch-up.
segments.tr: Por lo general, se fija en la cantidad mayor entre un monto fijo en dólares o el 150% de la aportación adicional regular.

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: Si cumple 64 años durante el año, por lo general vuelve a la aportación adicional estándar.

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **Requisito Roth para mayores ingresos.** A partir de 2026, los empleados cuyos salarios del año anterior del patrocinador del plan superen un umbral indexado deben realizar las aportaciones adicionales de tipo Roth (después de impuestos).

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Eso significa que no hay deducción fiscal inicial para esos dólares, pero los retiros cualificados pueden estar libres de impuestos más adelante.

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: Se proyecta que el umbral aumente a unos $155,000 para 2027.

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: Si su plan ofrece una opción Roth y cómo administra esta regla depende de su empleador.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## ¿Quiénes se benefician más?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **Personas con mayores ingresos y ahorradores al final de su carrera.** Quienes ya alcanzan el máximo de su plan tienen el mayor margen para aprovechar un tope superior. Quienes tienen entre 60 y 63 años obtienen el mayor aumento en dólares absolutos.

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **Trabajadores con aportación equivalente del empleador.** Un tope más alto no aumenta la aportación equivalente, pero puede ayudarle a alcanzarla si su tasa de aportación está vinculada a un porcentaje de su salario. Asegúrese siempre de obtener primero la aportación equivalente completa.

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Ahorradores que comenzaron tarde.** Las disposiciones de aportación adicional ofrecen una forma de recuperar el terreno perdido, aunque la cantidad que puede usar está limitada por sus ingresos y su flujo de caja.

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **Personas con ingresos bajos y medios.** Muchas personas no llegan al límite en absoluto, por lo que un tope más alto cambia poco. Para ellos, aumentar la tasa de aportación incluso en un punto porcentual puede importar más. El Crédito para el Ahorrador federal también puede ayudar a los hogares de menores ingresos elegibles.

segments.src: ## IRA Limits: Watch the Rounding
segments.tr: ## Límites de IRA: Cuidado con el redondeo

segments.src: IRA limits move in $500 steps, so forecasters are split on whether the 2027 cap stays at $7,500 or rises to $8,000.
segments.tr: Los límites de IRA se mueven en pasos de $500, por lo que los pronosticadores están divididos sobre si el tope de 2027 se mantendrá en $7,500 o subirá a $8,000.

segments.src: The IRA catch-up has been indexed in $100 steps.
segments.tr: La aportación adicional para IRA se ha indexado en pasos de $100.

segments.src: Separately, eligibility to deduct traditional IRA contributions or contribute directly to a Roth IRA depends on income and on whether you are covered by a workplace plan.
segments.tr: Por otra parte, la elegibilidad para deducir las aportaciones a una IRA tradicional o aportar directamente a una IRA Roth depende de los ingresos y de si está cubierto por un plan de empleo.

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: Estos rangos de ingresos también se ajustan cada año.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## Pasos prácticos para el otoño

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **Revise su aplazamiento en la nómina.** Muchos planes le permiten establecer un porcentaje o un monto en dólares. Si desea alcanzar un límite, divida el tope entre sus períodos de pago.

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: 2. **Tenga cuidado con la aportación anticipada (front-loading).** Si alcanza el tope a principios de año, algunos empleadores dejan de realizar aportaciones equivalentes durante los meses restantes. Distribuir las aportaciones puede ayudarle a obtener la contrapartida completa.

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **Consulte las opciones Roth de su plan.** Esto es más importante si está cerca del umbral salarial para la aportación adicional.

segments.src: 4. **Coordinate accounts.** The 401(k) limit applies per person across employers, while IRA limits are separate.
segments.tr: 4. **Coordine sus cuentas.** El límite de 401(k) se aplica por persona a través de los empleadores, mientras que los límites de IRA son independientes.

segments.src: 5. **Confirm figures with official sources.** Use IRS.gov or a qualified tax professional once the official notice is out.
segments.tr: 5. **Confirme las cifras con fuentes oficiales.** Utilice IRS.gov o consulte a un profesional fiscal cualificado una vez que se publique el aviso oficial.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Conclusión

segments.src: A larger contribution ceiling gives savers more room, but room is not the same as money in the account.
segments.tr: Un límite de aportación más amplio otorga a los ahorradores más espacio, pero el espacio no es lo mismo que el dinero en la cuenta.

segments.src: For most households, the biggest gains come from steady contributions, capturing the employer match, and keeping costs low.
segments.tr: Para la mayoría de los hogares, las mayores ganancias provienen de aportaciones constantes, obtener la aportación equivalente del empleador y mantener los costes bajos.

segments.src: Higher limits mainly help those who are already saving at the maximum and want to put away more.
segments.tr: Los límites más altos ayudan principalmente a quienes ya están ahorrando al máximo y desean destinar más dinero al ahorro.

fr.title: Plus d'espace pour l'épargne-retraite : ce que les plafonds 2027 des 401(k) et IRA pourraient signifier pour les épargnants

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service reviews retirement contribution caps and adjusts them for inflation.
segments.tr: Chaque automne, l'Internal Revenue Service examine les plafonds de cotisation à la retraite et les ajuste en fonction de l'inflation.

segments.src: The announcement for the 2027 tax year usually arrives between late October and mid-November, so many savers are watching for it now.
segments.tr: L'annonce pour l'année fiscale 2027 arrive généralement entre fin octobre et mi-novembre, de sorte que de nombreux épargnants l'attendent dès maintenant.

segments.src: This article explains how the limits work, what analysts currently expect, and which workers may gain the most.
segments.tr: Cet article explique le fonctionnement des plafonds, ce que les analystes prévoient actuellement et quels travailleurs pourraient y gagner le plus.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or tax advice.
segments.tr: Il s'agit d'informations générales, et non de conseils financiers ou fiscaux personnels.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Une note sur les chiffres

segments.src: At the time of writing, the figures below for 2027 are **projections from benefit consultants, not official IRS numbers**.
segments.tr: Au moment de la rédaction, les chiffres ci-dessous pour 2027 sont des **projections de consultants en prestations, et non des chiffres officiels de l'IRS**.

segments.src: Official limits are published by the IRS, so check IRS.gov before you change any contributions.
segments.tr: Les plafonds officiels sont publiés par l'IRS, veuillez donc consulter IRS.gov avant de modifier vos cotisations.

segments.src: The 2026 limits, by contrast, are final and serve as the baseline.
segments.tr: Les plafonds de 2026, en revanche, sont définitifs et servent de référence.

segments.src: ## How the Annual Adjustment Works
segments.tr: ## Comment fonctionne l'ajustement annuel

segments.src: Many retirement limits are indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: De nombreux plafonds de retraite sont indexés sur l'inflation.

segments.src: The IRS rounds the adjusted amounts in set increments.
segments.tr: L'IRS arrondit les montants ajustés selon des paliers déterminés.

segments.src: Because of that rounding, a modest rise in prices may not move every limit each year.
segments.tr: En raison de cet arrondi, une modeste hausse des prix peut ne pas modifier chaque plafond chaque année.

segments.src: Some caps jump while others stay flat.
segments.tr: Certains plafonds augmentent tandis que d'autres restent stables.

segments.src: ## The Numbers at a Glance
segments.tr: ## Les chiffres en un coup d'œil

segments.tr: | Plafond | 2026 (officiel) | 2027 (prévu) |

segments.tr: | 401(k), 403(b), et la plupart des reports salariaux 457(b) | $24,500 | environ $25,500 |

segments.tr: | Cotisation de rattrapage, 50 ans et plus | $8,000 | environ $8,500 |

segments.tr: | « Super » cotisation de rattrapage, 60 à 63 ans | $11,250 | environ $11,750 |

segments.tr: | Seuil de salaire pour le rattrapage Roth | $150,000 | environ $155,000 |

segments.src: If the projections hold, a worker under 50 could defer roughly $1,000 more into a workplace plan than in 2026.
segments.tr: Si les projections se vérifient, un travailleur de moins de 50 ans pourrait cotiser environ $1,000 de plus dans un plan d'entreprise qu'en 2026.

segments.src: A worker aged 60 to 63 could contribute up to about $37,250 in employee deferrals, counting the super catch-up.
segments.tr: Un travailleur âgé de 60 à 63 ans pourrait verser jusqu'à environ $37,250 en reports salariaux, en comptant la super cotisation de rattrapage.

segments.src: ## Catch-Up Rules to Understand
segments.tr: ## Règles de rattrapage à comprendre

segments.src: **Age 50 and over.** Workers who reach 50 by the end of the year can add a catch-up amount on top of the standard limit.
segments.tr: **50 ans et plus.** Les travailleurs qui atteignent 50 ans d'ici la fin de l'année peuvent ajouter un montant de rattrapage en plus du plafond standard.

segments.src: **Ages 60 to 63.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, people in this window may use a higher catch-up limit.
segments.tr: **60 à 63 ans.** En vertu de la loi SECURE 2.0, les personnes se trouvant dans cette tranche d'âge peuvent utiliser un plafond de rattrapage plus élevé.

segments.src: It is generally set at the greater of a fixed dollar amount or 150% of the regular catch-up.
segments.tr: Il est généralement fixé au plus élevé entre un montant fixe en dollars ou 150 % du rattrapage régulier.

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: Si vous avez 64 ans dans l'année, vous revenez généralement au rattrapage standard.

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **Exigence Roth pour les hauts revenus.** À compter de 2026, les employés dont les salaires de l'année précédente provenant du sponsor du plan dépassent un seuil indexé doivent effectuer des cotisations de rattrapage sur une base Roth (après impôt).

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Cela signifie pas de déduction fiscale initiale pour ces montants, mais les retraits admissibles peuvent être exonérés d'impôt par la suite.

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: Le seuil devrait passer à environ $155,000 pour 2027.

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: La question de savoir si votre plan propose une option Roth et la manière dont il applique cette règle dépend de votre employeur.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## Qui en profite le plus ?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **Hauts revenus et épargnants en fin de carrière.** Les personnes qui maximisent déjà leur plan disposent de la plus grande marge pour utiliser un plafond plus élevé. Celles âgées de 60 à 63 ans obtiennent la plus forte augmentation en valeur absolue.

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **Travailleurs bénéficiant d'une abondement de l'employeur.** Un plafond plus élevé n'augmente pas l'abondement, mais il peut vous aider l'atteindre si votre taux de cotisation est lié à un pourcentage de votre salaire. Obtenez toujours l'abondement complet en premier.

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Épargnants ayant commencé tard.** Les dispositions de rattrapage offrent un moyen de combler le retard, bien que le montant que vous pouvez utiliser soit limité par vos revenus et votre trésorerie.

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **Revenus faibles et moyens.** De nombreuses personnes n'atteignent pas du tout le plafond, de sorte qu'un plafond plus élevé change peu de choses. Pour elles, augmenter le taux de cotisation ne serait-ce que d'un point de pourcentage peut compter davantage. Le crédit d'impôt fédéral pour l'épargne peut également aider les ménages à faible revenu éligibles.

segments.src: ## IRA Limits: Watch the Rounding
segments.tr: ## Plafonds des IRA : attention aux arrondis

segments.src: IRA limits move in $500 steps, so forecasters are split on whether the 2027 cap stays at $7,500 or rises to $8,000.
segments.tr: Les plafonds des IRA évoluent par paliers de $500, de sorte que les prévisionnistes sont partagés sur le point de savoir si le plafond de 2027 restera à $7,500 ou passera à $8,000.

segments.src: The IRA catch-up has been indexed in $100 steps.
segments.tr: Le rattrapage IRA a été indexé par paliers de $100.

segments.src: Separately, eligibility to deduct traditional IRA contributions or contribute directly to a Roth IRA depends on income and on whether you are covered by a workplace plan.
segments.tr: Par ailleurs, l'éligibilité pour déduire les cotisations à un IRA traditionnel ou pour cotiser directement à un Roth IRA dépend des revenus et du fait que vous soyez ou non couvert par un plan d'entreprise.

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: Ces fourches de revenus sont également ajustées chaque année.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## Étapes pratiques pour l'automne

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **Vérifiez votre report sur salaire.** De nombreux plans vous permettent de définir un pourcentage ou un montant en dollars. Si vous souhaitez atteindre un plafond, divisez-le par vos périodes de paie.

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: **Attention au chargement anticipé.** Si vous atteignez le plafond au début de l'année, certains employeurs cessent de verser l'abondement pour les mois restants. Répartir les cotisations peut vous aider à percevoir l'abondement complet.

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **Vérifiez les options Roth de votre plan.** C'est particulièrement important si vous êtes proche du seuil de salaire pour le rattrapage.

segments.src: 4. **Coordinate accounts.** The 401(k) limit applies per person across employers, while IRA limits are separate.
segments.tr: 4. **Coordonnez vos comptes.** Le plafond du 401(k) s'applique par personne tous employeurs confondus, tandis que les plafonds des IRA sont distincts.

segments.src: 5. **Confirm figures with official sources.** Use IRS.gov or a qualified tax professional once the official notice is out.
segments.tr: 5. **Confirmez les chiffres auprès de sources officielles.** Utilisez IRS.gov ou un professionnel fiscal qualifié une fois l'avis officiel publié.

segments.tr: ## En résumé

in.title: Ruang Dana Pensiun yang Lebih Besar: Apa Artinya Batas 401(k) dan IRA 2027 bagi Penabung

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service reviews retirement contribution caps and adjusts them for inflation.
segments.tr: Setiap musim gugur, Internal Revenue Service meninjau batas kontribusi pensiun dan menyesuaikannya dengan inflasi.

segments.src: The announcement for the 2027 tax year usually arrives between late October and mid-November, so many savers are watching for it now.
segments.tr: Pengumuman untuk tahun pajak 2027 biasanya tiba antara akhir Oktober dan pertengahan November, jadi banyak penabung yang memantaunya sekarang.

segments.src: This article explains how the limits work, what analysts currently expect, and which workers may gain the most.
segments.tr: Artikel ini menjelaskan cara kerja batas tersebut, apa yang saat ini diharapkan oleh para analis, dan pekerja mana yang mungkin paling diuntungkan.

segments.src: It is general information, not personal financial or tax advice.
segments.tr: Ini adalah informasi umum, bukan nasihat keuangan atau pajak pribadi.

segments.src: ## A Note on the Numbers
segments.tr: ## Catatan Mengenai Angka-Angka

segments.src: At the time of writing, the figures below for 2027 are **projections from benefit consultants, not official IRS numbers**.
segments.tr: Pada saat penulisan, angka-angka di bawah ini untuk tahun 2027 adalah **proyeksi dari konsultan tunjangan, bukan angka resmi IRS**.

segments.src: Official limits are published by the IRS, so check IRS.gov before you change any contributions.
segments.tr: Batas resmi diterbitkan oleh IRS, jadi periksalah IRS.gov sebelum Anda mengubah kontribusi apa pun.

segments.src: The 2026 limits, by contrast, are final and serve as the baseline.
segments.tr: Sebaliknya, batas tahun 2026 bersifat final dan berfungsi sebagai garis dasar.

segments.src: ## How the Annual Adjustment Works
segments.tr: ## Cara Kerja Penyesuaian Tahunan

segments.src: Many retirement limits are indexed to inflation.
segments.tr: Banyak batas pensiun diindeks terhadap inflasi.

segments.src: The IRS rounds the adjusted amounts in set increments.
segments.tr: IRS membulatkan jumlah yang disesuaikan dalam kenaikan yang telah ditentukan.

segments.src: Because of that rounding, a modest rise in prices may not move every limit each year.
segments.tr: Karena pembulatan tersebut, kenaikan harga yang sederhana mungkin tidak menggeser setiap batas setiap tahunnya.

segments.src: Some caps jump while others stay flat.
segments.tr: Beberapa batasan melonjak sementara yang lain tetap datar.

segments.tr: Jika proyeksi tersebut bertahan, seorang pekerja di bawah usia 50 tahun dapat menangguhkan sekitar $1,000 lebih banyak ke dalam rencana tempat kerja dibandingkan pada tahun 2026.

segments.src: A worker aged 60 to 63 could contribute up to about $37,250 in employee deferrals, counting the super catch-up.
segments.tr: Seorang pekerja berusia 60 hingga 63 tahun dapat menyumbangkan hingga sekitar $37,250 dalam penangguhan karyawan, menghitung catch-up super.

segments.src: ## Catch-Up Rules to Understand
segments.tr: ## Aturan Catch-Up yang Perlu Dipahami

segments.src: **Age 50 and over.** Workers who reach 50 by the end of the year can add a catch-up amount on top of the standard limit.
segments.tr: **Usia 50 tahun ke atas.** Pekerja yang mencapai usia 50 tahun pada akhir tahun dapat menambahkan jumlah catch-up di atas batas standar.

segments.src: **Ages 60 to 63.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, people in this window may use a higher catch-up limit.
segments.tr: **Usia 60 hingga 63 tahun.** Berdasarkan Undang-Undang SECURE 2.0, orang-orang dalam rentang ini dapat menggunakan batas catch-up yang lebih tinggi.

segments.src: It is generally set at the greater of a fixed dollar amount or 150% of the regular catch-up.
segments.tr: Ini umumnya ditetapkan pada nilai yang lebih besar antara jumlah dolar tetap atau 150% dari catch-up reguler.

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: Jika Anda menginjak usia 64 tahun selama tahun tersebut, Anda biasanya kembali ke catch-up standar.

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **Persyaratan Roth untuk pendapatan tinggi.** Mulai tahun 2026, karyawan yang upah tahun sebelumnya dari sponsor rencana melebihi ambang batas terindeks harus melakukan kontribusi catch-up atas dasar Roth (setelah pajak).

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Itu berarti tidak ada potongan pajak di muka untuk dolar tersebut, tetapi penarikan yang memenuhi syarat dapat bebas pajak di kemudian hari.

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: Ambang batas tersebut diproyeksikan naik menjadi sekitar $155,000 untuk tahun 2027.

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: Apakah rencana Anda menawarkan opsi Roth, dan bagaimana cara mengelola aturan ini, bergantung pada pemberi kerja Anda.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## Siapa yang Paling Diuntungkan?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **Penerima pendapatan tinggi dan penabung karier akhir.** Orang yang sudah memaksimalkan rencana mereka memiliki ruang paling banyak untuk menggunakan batas yang lebih tinggi. Mereka yang berusia 60 hingga 63 tahun mendapatkan kenaikan terbesar dalam dolar mutlak.

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **Pekerja dengan kecocokan pemberi kerja (employer match).** Batas yang lebih tinggi tidak menaikkan kecocokan, tetapi dapat membantu Anda mencapainya jika tingkat kontribusi Anda terikat pada persentase gaji. Selalu dapatkan kecocokan penuh terlebih dahulu.

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Penabung yang terlambat memulai.** Ketentuan catch-up menawarkan cara untuk mengejar ketertinggalan, meskipun jumlah yang dapat Anda gunakan dibatasi oleh pendapatan dan arus kas Anda.

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **Penerima pendapatan rendah dan menengah.** Banyak orang tidak mencapai batas sama sekali, sehingga batas yang lebih tinggi sedikit mengubah keadaan. Bagi mereka, menaikkan tingkat kontribusi bahkan satu persentase poin mungkin lebih penting. Kredit Saver federal juga dapat membantu rumah tangga berpenghasilan rendah yang memenuhi syarat.

segments.tr: ## Batas IRA: Perhatikan Pembulatan

segments.tr: Catch-up IRA telah diindeks dalam langkah $100.

segments.tr: Secara terpisah, kelayakan untuk mengurangi kontribusi IRA tradisional atau berkontribusi langsung ke Roth IRA bergantung pada pendapatan dan apakah Anda dicakup oleh rencana tempat kerja.

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: Kisaran pendapatan ini juga disesuaikan setiap tahun.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## Langkah Praktis untuk Musim Gugur

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **Tinjau penangguhan penggajian Anda.** Banyak rencana memungkinkan Anda menetapkan persentase atau jumlah dolar. Jika Anda ingin mencapai batas, bagilah batas tersebut dengan periode pembayaran Anda.

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: 2. **Waspadai front-loading.** Jika Anda mencapai batas di awal tahun, beberapa pemberi kerja berhenti mencocokkan untuk bulan-bulan yang tersisa. Menyebarkan kontribusi dapat membantu Anda mengumpulkan kecocokan penuh.

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **Periksa opsi Roth rencana Anda.** Ini paling penting jika Anda mendekati ambang batas upah catch-up.

segments.src: Every autumn, the Internal Revenue Service reviews retirement contribution caps and adjusts them for inflation.

segments.src: ## Catch-Up Rules to Understand
segments.tr: ## Zu verstehende Regeln für Nachholbeiträge

segments.src: **Age 50 and over.** Workers who reach 50 by the end of the year can add a catch-up amount on top of the standard limit.
segments.tr: **Ab 50 Jahren.** Arbeitnehmer, die bis zum Ende des Jahres 50 werden, können zusätzlich zur Standardobergrenze einen Nachholbetrag einzahlen.

segments.src: **Ages 60 to 63.** Under the SECURE 2.0 Act, people in this window may use a higher catch-up limit.
segments.tr: **60 bis 63 Jahre.** Gemäß dem SECURE 2.0 Act können Personen in dieser Altersspanne eine höhere Obergrenze für Nachholbeiträge nutzen.

segments.src: It is generally set at the greater of a fixed dollar amount or 150% of the regular catch-up.
segments.tr: Sie ist im Allgemeinen auf den höheren Wert aus einem festen Dollarbetrag oder 150 % des regulären Nachholbeitrags festgelegt.

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: Wenn Sie im Laufe des Jahres 64 werden, kehren Sie normalerweise zur Standard-Nachholregelung zurück.

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **Roth-Anforderung für Besserverdiener.** Ab 2026 müssen Arbeitnehmer, deren Vorjahresgehalt vom Arbeitgeber des Plans einen indexierten Schwellenwert überschritten hat, Nachholbeiträge auf Roth-Basis (nach Steuern) leisten.

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Das bedeutet, dass es für diese Beträge keinen Vorab-Steuerabzug gibt, aber qualifizierte Auszahlungen können später steuerfrei sein.

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: Der Schwellenwert wird für 2027 voraussichtlich auf etwa 155.000 $ steigen.

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: Ob Ihr Plan eine Roth-Option anbietet und wie diese Regel angewendet wird, hängt von Ihrem Arbeitgeber ab.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## Wer profitiert am meisten?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **Besserverdiener und Sparer kurz vor der Rente.** Menschen, die ihren Plan bereits voll ausschöpfen, haben den größten Spielraum, eine höhere Obergrenze zu nutzen. Diejenigen im Alter von 60 bis 63 Jahren erhalten den größten Anstieg in absoluten Dollarbeträgen.

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **Arbeitnehmer mit Arbeitgeberzuschuss.** Eine höhere Obergrenze erhöht den Zuschuss nicht, aber sie kann Ihnen helfen, ihn zu erreichen, wenn Ihre Beitragsrate an einen Prozentsatz des Gehalts gebunden ist. Sichern Sie sich immer zuerst den vollen Zuschuss.

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Sparer, die spät angefangen haben.** Nachholregelungen bieten eine Möglichkeit, verlorenen Boden gutzumachen, obwohl der Betrag, den Sie nutzen können, durch Ihr Einkommen und Ihren Cashflow begrenzt ist.

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **Gering- und Mittelverdiener.** Viele Menschen erreichen das Limit gar nicht, daher ändert eine höhere Obergrenze wenig. Für sie kann es wichtiger sein, die Beitragsrate um nur einen Prozentpunkt zu erhöhen. Der staatliche Saver's Credit kann ebenfalls einkommensschwächeren Haushalten helfen.

segments.src: If you turn 64 during the year, you typically go back to the standard catch-up.
segments.tr: Nếu bạn bước sang tuổi 64 trong năm, bạn thường quay lại mức bù đắp tiêu chuẩn.

segments.src: **Roth requirement for higher earners.** Beginning in 2026, employees whose prior-year wages from the plan's sponsor exceeded an indexed threshold must make catch-up contributions on a Roth (after-tax) basis.
segments.tr: **Yêu cầu Roth đối với người có thu nhập cao hơn.** Bắt đầu từ năm 2026, những nhân viên có tiền lương năm trước từ nhà tài trợ của kế hoạch vượt quá ngưỡng được lập chỉ mục phải thực hiện các khoản đóng góp bù đắp trên cơ sở Roth (sau thuế).

segments.src: That means no upfront tax deduction for those dollars, but qualified withdrawals can be tax-free later.
segments.tr: Điều đó có nghĩa là không được khấu trừ thuế trả trước cho những số tiền đó, nhưng các khoản rút tiền đủ điều kiện có thể được miễn thuế sau này.

segments.src: The threshold is projected to rise to about $155,000 for 2027.
segments.tr: Ngưỡng này dự kiến sẽ tăng lên khoảng $155,000 cho năm 2027.

segments.src: Whether your plan offers a Roth option, and how it administers this rule, depends on your employer.
segments.tr: Liệu kế hoạch của bạn có cung cấp tùy chọn Roth hay không và cách kế hoạch đó quản lý quy tắc này tùy thuộc vào chủ lao động của bạn.

segments.src: ## Who Benefits Most?
segments.tr: ## Ai được hưởng lợi nhiều nhất?

segments.src: - **Higher earners and late-career savers.** People who already max out their plan have the most room to use a higher cap. Those aged 60 to 63 get the largest increase in absolute dollars.
segments.tr: - **Người có thu nhập cao và người tiết kiệm cuối sự nghiệp.** Những người đã tối đa hóa kế hoạch của họ có nhiều không gian nhất để sử dụng mức trần cao hơn. Những người từ 60 đến 63 tuổi nhận được mức tăng lớn nhất tính theo số tiền tuyệt đối.

segments.src: - **Workers with an employer match.** A higher cap does not raise the match, but it can help you reach it if your contribution rate is tied to a percentage of pay. Always capture the full match first.
segments.tr: - **Người lao động có chủ lao động đóng góp tương đương.** Mức trần cao hơn không làm tăng mức đóng góp tương đương, nhưng nó có thể giúp bạn đạt được mức đó nếu tỷ lệ đóng góp của bạn gắn liền với tỷ lệ phần trăm tiền lương. Luôn luôn tận dụng tối đa khoản đóng góp tương đương trước tiên.

segments.src: - **Savers who started late.** Catch-up provisions offer a way to make up lost ground, though the amount you can use is limited by your income and cash flow.
segments.tr: - **Người tiết kiệm bắt đầu muộn.** Các điều khoản bù đắp cung cấp một cách để bù đắp phần đã mất, mặc dù số tiền bạn có thể sử dụng bị giới hạn bởi thu nhập và dòng tiền của bạn.

segments.src: - **Lower and middle earners.** Many people do not reach the limit at all, so a higher cap changes little. For them, raising the contribution rate by even one percentage point may matter more. The federal Saver's Credit may also help eligible lower-income households.
segments.tr: - **Người có thu nhập thấp và trung bình.** Nhiều người không đạt được giới hạn, vì vậy mức trần cao hơn thay đổi không đáng kể. Đối với họ, việc nâng tỷ lệ đóng góp lên dù chỉ một điểm phần trăm cũng có thể quan trọng hơn. Tín dụng tiết kiệm liên bang (Saver's Credit) cũng có thể giúp ích cho các hộ gia đình có thu nhập thấp đủ điều kiện.

segments.src: ## IRA Limits: Watch the Rounding
segments.tr: ## Giới hạn IRA: Chú ý việc làm tròn số

segments.src: IRA limits move in $500 steps, so forecasters are split on whether the 2027 cap stays at $7,500 or rises to $8,000.
segments.tr: Giới hạn IRA di chuyển theo các bước $500, vì vậy các nhà dự báo bị chia rẽ về việc liệu mức trần năm 2027 có giữ ở mức $7,500 hay tăng lên $8,000.

segments.src: The IRA catch-up has been indexed in $100 steps.
segments.tr: Khoản bù đắp IRA đã được lập chỉ mục theo các bước $100.

segments.src: Separately, eligibility to deduct traditional IRA contributions or contribute directly to a Roth IRA depends on income and on whether you are covered by a workplace plan.
segments.tr: Ngoài ra, tính đủ điều kiện để khấu trừ các khoản đóng góp IRA truyền thống hoặc đóng góp trực tiếp vào IRA Roth phụ thuộc vào thu nhập và việc bạn có được bảo hiểm bởi một kế hoạch tại nơi làm việc hay không.

segments.src: These income ranges are also adjusted each year.
segments.tr: Các khoảng thu nhập này cũng được điều chỉnh mỗi năm.

segments.src: ## Practical Steps for the Fall
segments.tr: ## Các bước thiết thực cho mùa thu

segments.src: 1. **Review your payroll deferral.** Many plans let you set a percentage or a dollar amount. If you want to hit a limit, divide the cap by your pay periods.
segments.tr: 1. **Xem lại khoản khấu trừ lương của bạn.** Nhiều kế hoạch cho phép bạn đặt tỷ lệ phần trăm hoặc số tiền cụ thể. Nếu bạn muốn đạt giới hạn, hãy chia mức trần cho các kỳ trả lương của bạn.

segments.src: 2. **Beware of front-loading.** If you reach the cap early in the year, some employers stop matching for the remaining months. Spreading contributions can help you collect the full match.
segments.tr: 2. **Cẩn thận với việc dồn tiền từ đầu năm.** Nếu bạn đạt mức trần sớm trong năm, một số chủ lao động sẽ ngừng đóng góp tương đương cho các tháng còn lại. Phân bổ các khoản đóng góp có thể giúp bạn thu thập đủ khoản đóng góp tương đương.

segments.src: 3. **Check your plan's Roth options.** This matters most if you are near the catch-up wage threshold.
segments.tr: 3. **Kiểm tra các tùy chọn Roth của kế hoạch của bạn.** Điều này quan trọng nhất nếu bạn đang ở gần ngưỡng tiền lương bù đắp.

segments.src: 4. **Coordinate accounts.** The 401(k) limit applies per person across employers, while IRA limits are separate.
segments.tr: 4. **Phối hợp các tài khoản.** Giới hạn 401(k) áp dụng cho mỗi cá nhân trên tất cả các chủ lao động, trong khi các giới hạn IRA là riêng biệt.

segments.src: 5. **Confirm figures with official sources.** Use IRS.gov or a qualified tax professional once the official notice is out.
segments.tr: 5. **Xác nhận số liệu với các nguồn chính thức.** Sử dụng IRS.gov hoặc một chuyên gia thuế có trình độ sau khi có thông báo chính thức.

segments.src: ## The Bottom Line
segments.tr: ## Điểm mấu chốt

segments.src: A larger contribution ceiling gives savers more room, but room is not the same as money in the account.
segments.tr: Giới hạn đóng góp lớn hơn mang lại cho người tiết kiệm nhiều không gian hơn, nhưng không gian không giống như tiền trong tài khoản.

segments.src: For most households, the biggest gains come from steady contributions, capturing the employer match, and keeping costs low.
segments.tr: Đối với hầu hết các hộ gia đình, lợi ích lớn nhất đến từ việc đóng góp đều đặn, thu được khoản đóng góp tương đương từ chủ lao động và giữ chi phí ở mức thấp.

segments.src: Higher limits mainly help those who are already saving at the maximum and want to put away more.
segments.tr: Giới hạn cao hơn chủ yếu giúp những người đã tiết kiệm ở mức tối đa và muốn cất giữ nhiều hơn.
